messages.subject: Time recording reminder - January WIP
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Tom,

Our records show unposted time for January across two of your matters. Please ensure all January time is recorded and released by Friday 28 February so we can run month-end billing. If any entries should be written off, let us know and we'll arrange.

Many thanks,
Accounts
Whitfield Carter LLP
